about_the_game:
Awaken in a shattered realm…
Step into a world steeped in ancient mystery and haunting beauty. In Code: J4, you awaken on a blood-stained altar, disoriented yet driven by a singular purpose—to unravel the secrets of a fallen world where remnants of old power still linger. This isn’t just a visual novel; it’s an emotional odyssey where every decision shapes your destiny and that of a captivating beauty whose enigmatic past holds the key to salvation.

Forge a Unique Bond
Interact intimately with the mysterious maiden—a gentle yet resolute soul whose elegance belies a turbulent history. Engage in dynamic conversations and pivotal choices that reveal layers of her character. Whether sharing quiet moments of reflection or confronting the lingering shadows of her past, your words and actions will directly influence her feelings, forging a bond that may alter the fate of a decaying world.

Branching Paths and Multiple Endings
Every conversation, every choice, unlocks new narrative pathways. Experience a richly branching storyline where moments of tenderness and sudden peril coexist. Will you guide her toward redemption, or will the weight of forgotten curses drag you both deeper into despair? The outcome rests entirely on the decisions you make throughout your journey.

Stunning Art and Atmospheric Sound
Immerse yourself in meticulously hand-drawn visuals that capture the ethereal beauty and decay of a once-glorious civilization. Paired with an evocative, atmospheric soundtrack, each scene is crafted to pull you further into a world where ancient legends meet modern storytelling—a visual and auditory feast that enhances every twist of the narrative.

A Journey of Self-Discovery
More than a game, Code: J4 is a story about the resilience of the human spirit and the transformative power of connection. As you walk beside the maiden on her quest to reclaim lost glory and confront the remnants of a corrupted past, you too will discover that every end is merely a new beginning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or later
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT520 or above
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920*1080 or the same scale resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or later
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT520 or above
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920*1080 or the same scale resolution

short_description: Code: J4 is an interactive visual novel set in a mysterious ancient realm. Featuring branching narratives, exquisite hand-drawn art, and evocative music, every key choice shapes the fate of a beguiling maiden and unveils secrets of a forgotten era.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
